text: Residents on Victor Avenue have reached out to my office regarding concerns of non-permit parking on their street. This is a residential street close to a very busy park and businesses. Residents submitted a petition to my office and in a subsequent confidential ballot, there was 63 percent support for this change.

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Authorized additional period of permit parking only on Victor Avenue between Broadview Avenue and Howland Road between 4:00 p.m. and 7:00 p.m., Monday to Friday, in addition to the existing permit parking restriction from 12:01 a.m. to 10:00 a.m.
